text:
mira: kicked off a focused bring-up for marigold-mini-v1 targeting short/long-tail split + cross-lang holdouts. comparing f32 baseline, int8-ptq, int4-per-channel. summary below and links to artifacts.

embed-ci-bot: CI run 4401234500 summary: marigold-mini-v1
- baseline (f32): R@1=0.704 R@5=0.883 R@10=0.921 silhouette=0.51
- int8 (PTQ): R@1=0.695 R@5=0.876 R@10=0.916 silhouette=0.50
- int4 (per-channel PTQ): R@1=0.668 R@5=0.854 R@10=0.895 silhouette=0.44
- long-tail cohort R@1 (f32)=0.582, (int8)=0.571, (int4)=0.539
- cross-lang (en->es) R@1 (f32)=0.642, (int4)=0.614
Artifacts: https://redwood.internal/runs/4401234500/artifacts (umap + per-query csv + logs)

david: int4 per-channel cut the gap vs per-tensor but still ~3.6 pts abs drop vs baseline overall and long-tail is hit harder.

olga: can you paste the eval invocation? want to replicate on my laptop.

mira: eval command:
```bash
./eval/run_holdouts.sh \
  --model marigold-mini-v1 \
  --quant perchannel_int4 \
  --holdouts recall_longtail,recall_short,recall_crosslang_es \
  --index hnsw --k 10 --seed 2026 \
  --calib_samples 8192
```

pranav: quick glance at per-query diffs: int4 changes NN ordering for ~9% of queries, most are long-tail low-frequency tokens. top features: subword rare tokens and punctuation-heavy queries.

david: hypothesis: calibration dataset missing tail distribution. we used uniform sampling across corpus for calib_samples. that biases scales to high-freq tokens. try stratified calibration (oversample low-freq tokens) or a token-aware per-channel asymmetric scale.

olga: also worth trying int8 QAT warm-start for 10 epochs on stratified samples — we saw improved long-tail retention before with QAT. costlier but might be necessary for customer-facing short-query routes.

mira: agreed. immediate plan: 1) re-run per-channel int4 with stratified calibration (tail-heavy) 2) small int8-QAT pass focusing long-tail 3) run end-to-end index+re-rank test (PQ coarse 64 -> HNSW) to measure system-level R@1 impact.

embed-ci-bot: queued job 4401234601 (int4 per-channel stratified calib). ETA ~18m. logs will post back here.

pranav: adding a quick A/B pack of 250 long-tail queries for a blind human check. will prepare labels + canonical ground truth.

david: also can we simulate runtime impact? per-channel int4 uses slightly more memory. olga, can you run microbench: 1000 queries p95 latency for per-tensor int4 vs per-channel int4 vs int8?

olga: will run. rough numbers: per-tensor int4 p95=7.4ms, per-channel int4 p95=8.3ms, int8 p95=9.6ms (on c6g-gpu-sim node) but i'll confirm on real infra.

mira: thanks. if stratified int4 recovers >0.02 absolute R@1 on long-tail, we can consider delegating short-query routes to int4 with an Rerank fallback. otherwise int8-QAT will be default.

embed-ci-bot: run 4401234601 started. artifacts link: https://redwood.internal/runs/4401234601

mira: i'll loop back with per-query diff heatmap and a short runbook after the stratified run completes. tagging @pranav for human eval.

pranav: got it, prepping pack now.

david: thanks team. we'll avoid rolling this variant to hosted until we have the human A/B and stratified probe results.
